instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper. (Cut the parchment paper a bit larger than the dish, then use your hands to press and crease it so that it keeps its shape in the dish. It doesn't have to be perfect since the cookie dough will help hold it in place!)
Set a ⅓-cup of whole mini eggs aside for later use. Place remaining mini eggs in a resealable plastic bag, then gently crush using a rolling pin or the bottom of a saucepan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ⅓ cups mini chocolate candy eggs

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups all-purpose flour
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Carefully melt butter in a small saucepan or a microwave. Transfer melted butter to another medium bowl, add sugar, then beat with a hand-held electric mixer until fully combined and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup butter, unsalted
1 cup brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Add egg and vanilla to the bowl with the butter mixture, then beat once more until combined, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed. Add the flour mixture and stir well to combine the dough.
Add the crushed mini eggs to the bowl with the dough and stir once more to combine. Transfer dough to the baking dish, then use your fingers (or small hands) to spread it out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the cookie is golden, 15-18 minutes.
When the cookie is done, remove from the oven, and immediately sprinkle with reserved whole mini eggs, gently pressing them into the top. Set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
Cut cookie into 16 bars, share, and enjoy!
